A '''battle''' took place in the [[Herdessa system/Legends|Herdessa system]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict fought in [[3996 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] won the battle.<ref name="TEA" />
